reuse.why: Extends the existing getMonthWideCategories selection and uses the shared extractTagsFromText to recognise the tag.

duplication.why: The exclusion is added once in the shared selection function; no query or check is copied.

placement.why: The rule sits in getMonthWideCategories, the single function every month-wide action (including copyPreviousMonth) already uses.

scope.why: Only the selection function, its comment and a focused test extension are changed.

maintainability.why: Small, documented change in one place that reuses the app's tag parser; a maintainer can see all exclusions together.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions call getMonthWideCategories; tag parsing goes through #shared/tags.

one_place.where: getMonthWideCategories in budget/actions.ts, used by copyPreviousMonth, setZero, setLastMonthSpending and the 3/6/12-month averages.
